```yaml
name: ghalint

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/**/*.yml
      - .github/workflows/**/*.yaml
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/**/*.yml
      - .github/workflows/**/*.yaml

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint GitHub Actions workflows
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Filter changed workflow files
        id: filter
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v2
        with:
          filters: |
            changes:
              - .github/workflows/**/*.yml
              - .github/workflows/**/*.yaml

      - name: Run ghalint
        if: steps.filter.outputs.changes == 'true'
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/suzuki-shunsuke/ghalint/releases/download/v1.5.1/ghalint_linux_amd64 -o ghalint
          chmod +x ghalint
          ./ghalint -f .github/workflows
        shell: bash
```
